title: Относительные придаточные: who / which / that / where / whose

why: Относительные придаточные отвечают на вопрос «какой?» и позволяют соединить два предложения в одно: «Человек, который позвонил, мой коллега». В русском «который» меняется по родам и падежам, а в английском выбор слова зависит от того, о ком или о чём мы говорим.
formation: • who — для людей: The man who called me is my boss.
• which — для предметов и животных: The laptop which I bought is fast.
• that — и для людей, и для предметов (разговорный вариант вместо who / which): The app that I use is free.
• where — для мест: This is the café where we met.
• whose — «чей / чья / чьё» (принадлежность): I know a girl whose father is a pilot.
• Порядок: существительное + who / which / that + (подлежащее) + глагол.
usage: 1. who / that — человек выполняет действие (подлежащее придаточного).
The woman who works here is very helpful. (Женщина, которая здесь работает, очень помогает.)
This is the book which changed my life. (Это книга, которая изменила мою жизнь.)
Show me the office where you work. (Покажи офис, где ты работаешь.)
He is a developer whose app has a million users. (Он разработчик, чьё приложение имеет миллион пользователей.)
5. Если слово относится к объекту придаточного, его можно опустить.
The movie (that) we watched was boring. (Фильм, который мы смотрели, был скучным.) Но если слово относится к подлежащему, опускать нельзя: The man who lives next door is a teacher.
signalWords: вопрос к существительному: кто? (who), что? (which / that), где? (where), чей? (whose). После all, everything, something, nothing обычно ставим that: Everything that he said was true.
mistakes: ✗ The man which lives here is nice. → ✓ The man who lives here is nice. (для людей — who)
✗ The book what I read was good. → ✓ The book that I read was good. (what в роли «который» не используем)
✗ The man who he called is my friend. → ✓ The man who called him is my friend. / The man (who) he called is my friend. (нельзя повторять he после who как подлежащее)
✗ This is the house where I was born in it. → ✓ This is the house where I was born. (лишнее местоимение не добавляем)
✗ A girl who her father is a pilot → ✓ A girl whose father is a pilot. (принадлежность — whose)
remember: Who — люди, which — вещи, that — и те, и другие, where — места, whose — чьё.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте who, which, where или whose

items.prompt: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
items.answer: who

items.prompt: This is the restaurant ___ we had dinner last week.
items.answer: where

items.prompt: I have a laptop ___ is very fast.
items.answer: which

items.prompt: He is a friend ___ brother works at Google.
items.answer: whose

items.prompt: The people ___ work in my office are friendly.
items.answer: who

items.prompt: Do you remember the hotel ___ we stayed in Rome?
items.answer: where

items.prompt: The book ___ I am reading now is interesting.
items.answer: which

items.prompt: She is a designer ___ projects always win awards.
items.answer: whose

items.prompt: The man (a) which (b) who called you is my boss.
items.answer: (b) who

items.prompt: This is the app (a) who (b) that helps me to learn English.
items.answer: (b) that

items.prompt: I know a girl (a) whose (b) who father works in London.
items.answer: (a) whose

items.prompt: The city (a) where (b) which I was born is small.
items.answer: (a) where

items.prompt: Everything (a) what (b) that he said was true.
items.answer: (b) that

items.prompt: The phone (a) who (b) which is on the table is mine.
items.answer: (b) which

items.prompt: The colleague (a) that (b) where I work with is very smart.
items.answer: (a) that

items.prompt: Do you know the person (a) whose (b) who car is parked outside?
items.answer: (a) whose

exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения в одно, используя who / which / where / whose

items.prompt: I have a friend. He lives in Canada. (who)
items.answer: I have a friend who lives in Canada.

items.prompt: This is the book. I bought it yesterday. (which)
items.answer: This is the book which I bought yesterday. / This is the book I bought yesterday.

items.prompt: That is the café. We often meet there. (where)
items.answer: That is the café where we often meet.

items.prompt: She is a developer. Her app is very popular. (whose)
items.answer: She is a developer whose app is very popular.

items.prompt: The man is my uncle. He is standing at the door. (who)
items.answer: The man who is standing at the door is my uncle.

items.prompt: The city is beautiful. I live there. (where)
items.answer: The city where I live is beautiful.

items.prompt: The car is expensive. It is parked outside. (which)
items.answer: The car which is parked outside is expensive.

items.prompt: I met a woman. Her daughter studies with my son. (whose)
items.answer: I met a woman whose daughter studies with my son.

items.prompt: The man which lives next door is a teacher.
items.answer: The man who lives next door is a teacher.

items.prompt: The book what I read was great.
items.answer: The book that I read was great. / The book which I read was great.

items.prompt: She is a girl who her father is a pilot.
items.answer: She is a girl whose father is a pilot.

items.prompt: This is the house where I was born in.
items.answer: This is the house where I was born. / This is the house which I was born in.

items.prompt: The woman who she called me is my boss.
items.answer: The woman who called me is my boss.

items.prompt: Everything which he said was true.
items.answer: Everything that he said was true.

items.prompt: The film that I watched it was boring.
items.answer: The film that I watched was boring.

items.prompt: I know a man who his dog can talk.
items.answer: I know a man whose dog can talk.

items.prompt: Человек, который позвонил вчера, мой новый коллега.
items.answer: The man who called yesterday is my new colleague. / The man that called yesterday is my new colleague.

items.prompt: Это приложение, которое помогает мне учить слова.
items.answer: This is the app which helps me learn words. / This is the app that helps me learn words. / This is the app that helps me to learn words.

items.prompt: Вот кафе, где мы познакомились.
items.answer: Here is the café where we met. / This is the café where we met.

items.prompt: Я знаю разработчика, чей сайт посещают миллионы людей.
items.answer: I know a developer whose website is visited by millions of people. / I know a developer whose site millions of people visit.

items.prompt: Фильм, который мы смотрели вчера, был очень интересным.
items.answer: The movie we watched yesterday was very interesting. / The film that we watched yesterday was very interesting. / The movie that we watched yesterday was very interesting.

items.prompt: Отель, где мы остановились, был недорогим.
items.answer: The hotel where we stayed was cheap. / The hotel where we stayed wasn't expensive.

items.prompt: У меня есть подруга, которая работает в Берлине.
items.answer: I have a friend who works in Berlin. / I have a friend that works in Berlin.

items.prompt: Всё, что она сказала, было правдой.
items.answer: Everything that she said was true. / Everything she said was true.
